# HVB.software

## About HVB.software
HVB.software specializes in AI-first software development. We design innovative applications and automate business processes using no-code tools like n8n.

## Services
- **AI-First Software Development**: Custom AI solutions, agentic systems, and intelligent applications.
- **Development & AI Integration**: Upgrading existing systems with AI capabilities (LLMs, etc.).
- **Process Automation (No-Code)**: Streamlining business operations using n8n and other automation tools.
- **AI Training & Workshops**: Educating teams on AI adoption and implementation.

## Technologies
- **Backend**: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Python
- **Frontend**: React, React Native, Flutter, TypeScript
- **AI/Data**: Agent Development Kit, LangChain, ElasticSearch
- **Cloud/Infra**: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), MongoDB, PostgreSQL
- **Automation**: n8n

## Founders
- **Jakub Prądzyński**: Engineering Manager & Senior Software Engineer (Java/Kotlin, Spring, Big Data, AI).
- **Piotr Prądzyński**: Senior Software Engineer (Java/Kotlin, Spring Boot, Elasticsearch, AI Voice Solutions).

## Key Projects
- **JiroAI.pl**: Intelligent AI assistant for Polish businesses.
- **HomeDecoratorAI.com**: AI platform for interior design.
- **ProgramistaNaSwoim.pl**: Resources for self-employed programmers.
- **PrzeglądAI.news**: AI industry newsletter.
